FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Fresh Haven Grocery, we operate a retail space dedicated to providing high-quality food and grocery items to our local community. Our store features a wide selection of fresh produce, canned goods, frozen foods, and essential household items. We are committed to maintaining the highest standards of food safety and cleanliness; however, we currently face some unresolved food safety violations that we are actively working to remediate. Our spacious layout makes it easy for customers to navigate through the store, and we are focused on improving our operations while ensuring a safe shopping experience for everyone.

Our grocery store regularly re-evaluates our food safety practices and occasionally addresses any concerns raised by health inspections to ensure our products meet the highest standards.
